final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.customer_id, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.customer_id), town_totals AS (SELECT c.town_city, SUM(ac.transaction_count) AS town_transactions FROM account_counts ac JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id GROUP BY c.town_city), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM account_counts) SELECT ac.account_id, c.town_city, ac.transaction_count, ac.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(tt.town_transactions, 0) AS town_transaction_share, ac.transaction_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.average_count, 0) AS ratio_to_average FROM account_counts ac JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id JOIN town_totals tt ON tt.town_city = c.town_city CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, ac.account_id LIMIT 10
